text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган beats Нарита Брайан, but
realizes
there is something else Narita
Brian is searching
for—something
separate from the results of the
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Curious to discover what it is Narita
Brian desires,
Mayano Top Gun wants to
race against her again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, when she hears from Hishi
Amazon that
Нарита Брайан is not planning
on racing again after
the Arima Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Vowing to become a racer capable of
exciting
even Нарита Брайан, she sets her
sights on the G1
race in which the best
racers compete—the
Takarazuka Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
